-- ===========================================================
-- Title		:	umsp_RetrieveCharacterList
-- (author line removed)
-- Create date	:	2012-04-12
-- Description	:	3개의 Parameter 중 1개의 조건에 한하여 동작
--					우선 순위는 Parameter 순서
-- ===========================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.umsp_RetrieveCharacterList
(
	@GameAccountID	UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@PCID			BIGINT,
	@CharacterName	NVARCHAR(32)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT, XACT_ABORT ON;
	
	DECLARE	@INIT_TRANCOUNT		INT	= @@TRANCOUNT,
			-- Error Code
			@ERR_SUCCESS		INT = 0,
			@ERR_FAILURE		INT = 1;
	
	BEGIN TRY
		-- Transaction validity check
		IF	(@@NESTLEVEL = 1 AND @INIT_TRANCOUNT > 0)
			RAISERROR(N'invalid initial transaction, init trancount:%d', 16, @ERR_FAILURE, @INIT_TRANCOUNT);
		
		-- Parameter validity check
		IF	(	@GameAccountID IS NULL
				AND	ISNULL(@PCID, -1) <= 0
				AND	ISNULL(@CharacterName, N'') = N''	)	BEGIN
			DECLARE	@gameAccountIdStr	NCHAR(36) = CAST(@GameAccountID AS NCHAR(36));
			RAISERROR(N'invalid parameter, gameAccountId:%s, pcId:0x%I64X, characterName:%s', 16, @ERR_FAILURE, @gameAccountIdStr, @PCID, @CharacterName);
		END
		
		BEGIN
			IF	(@GameAccountID IS NOT NULL)	BEGIN
				SELECT	[Character].PCID,
						[Character].GameAccountID,
						[Character].SlotID,
						[Character].WorldID,
						[Character].CharacterName,
						[Character].CharacterRight,
						[Character].CharacterState,
						[Character].RegistrationTime,
						[Character].DeletionDelayTime,
						CASE	[Character].CharacterState
							WHEN	6	THEN	[Character].LastStateUpdateTime
							ELSE	NULL
						END	DeletionTime,
						[Character].LastPlayStartTime,
						[Character].LastPlayEndTime,
						[Character].LastPlayIPv4Address,
						Block.BlockID,
						Block.BlockerName,
						Block.BlockComment,
						Block.BlockTime
				FROM	(
							SELECT	PCID,
									GameAccountID,
									SlotID,
									WorldID,
									CharacterName,
									CharacterRight,
									CharacterState,
									RegistrationTime,
									LastStateUpdateTime,
									DeletionDelayTime,
									LastPlayStartTime,
									LastPlayEndTime,
									LastPlayIPv4Address
							FROM	dbo.[Character]
							WITH	(READUNCOMMITTED, INDEX(IX_Character_GameAccountID_CharacterState))
							WHERE	GameAccountID	= @GameAccountID
						)	[Character]
						LEFT OUTER LOOP JOIN
						(
							SELECT	BlockID,
									PCID,
									BlockerName,
									BlockComment,
									BlockTime,
									ReleaseTime
							FROM	dbo.Block
							WITH	(READUNCOMMITTED)
						)	Block
						ON	[Character].PCID	= Block.PCID
						AND	Block.ReleaseTime	IS NULL;
			END
			ELSE IF	(@PCID > 0)	BEGIN
				SELECT	[Character].PCID,
						[Character].GameAccountID,
						[Character].SlotID,
						[Character].WorldID,

					Usable,
					Enterable,
					CharacterCreationLimit,
					CharacterOfNewAccountCreationLimit,
					BrandNew,
					Recommendation,
					Crowdedness,
					ISNULL([1] + [2] + [3] + [4] + [5] + [6], 0)	N'TotalCount',
					ISNULL([1], 0)	N'CreationTry',
					ISNULL([2], 0)	N'CreationCompletion',
					ISNULL([3], 0)	N'DeletionTry',
					ISNULL([4], 0)	N'DeletionWaiting',
					ISNULL([5], 0)	N'RestorationTry',
					ISNULL([6], 0)	N'DeletionCompletion'
			FROM	(
						SELECT	WorldID,
								WorldClusterID,
								WorldName,
								Usable,
								Enterable,
								CharacterCreationLimit,
								CharacterOfNewAccountCreationLimit,
								BrandNew,
								Recommendation,
								Crowdedness
						FROM	dbo.GameWorld
						WITH	(READUNCOMMITTED)
					)	World
					LEFT OUTER MERGE JOIN
					(
						SELECT	WorldID,
								[1],
								[2],

-- ===========================================================
-- Title		:	usp_CharacterMove_CheckCharacter
-- (author line removed)
-- Create date	:	2016-06-15
-- Description	:	캐릭터 정보 수집
-- ===========================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE usp_CharacterMove_CheckCharacter
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT, XACT_ABORT ON;
	
	DECLARE	@INIT_TRANCOUNT		INT	= @@TRANCOUNT,
			-- Error Code
			@ERR_SUCCESS		
			INT = 0,
			@ERR_FAILURE		INT = 1;
	
	BEGIN TRY
		-- Transaction validity check
		IF	(@@NESTLEVEL = 1 AND @INIT_TRANCOUNT > 0)
			RAISERROR(N'invalid initial transaction, init trancount:%d', 16, @ERR_FAILURE, @INIT_TRANCOUNT);
		
		IF	(@INIT_TRANCOUNT = 0)
			BEGIN TRAN
		
		BEGIN
			--0.지난 프로세스 정리
			UPDATE CharacterMoveProcess
			SET Data = '<Done />',
				ExecuteStatus = 4
			WHERE ExecuteStatus = 3

			UPDATE CharacterMoveProcess
			SET ExecuteStatus = 0
			WHERE ExecuteStatus IN (1,2)

			-- 시스템에러(-8,16384) 처리
			UPDATE dbo.CharacterMove
			SET 
				MoveState = -8, 
				Errors = 16384
			WHERE MoveState IN (1,2,3,4,5)
			
			DECLARE @SAME_WORLDCLUSTER SMALLINT = 1
			DECLARE @ACCOUNT_DELETED SMALLINT = 2
			DECLARE @CHARACTER_DELETE_DELAYED SMALLINT = 4
			DECLARE @CHARACTER_DELETED SMALLINT = 8
			DECLARE @UNDER16LEVEL SMALLINT = 16
			
			--1.같은클러스터ID 불가
			UPDATE mov
			SET 
				MoveState = -1,
				Errors = --Errors + 
				@SAME_WORLDCLUSTER
			FROM dbo.CharacterMove AS mov
				INNER JOIN Character AS cha
					ON mov.PCID = cha.PCID
				INNER JOIN GameWorld AS old
					on cha.WorldID = old.WorldID
				INNER JOIN GameWorld As new
					on mov.NewWorldID = new.WorldID
			WHERE MoveState = 0 
				AND CharacterState = 2
				AND old.WorldClusterID = new.WorldClusterID
				
			--2.삭제된 계정 불가
			UPDATE dbo.CharacterMove
			SET 
				MoveState = -1,
				Errors = --Errors + 
				@ACCOUNT_DELETED
			WHERE MoveState = 0
				AND NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT PCID FROM Character AS cha WHERE cha.PCID = CharacterMove.PCID
				)
				
			--3.삭제대기 캐릭터 불가 --플랫폼개발지원실 요청으로 체크안함 TT14675 => TT를 찾을 수 없고, CharacterState 조건값을 수정하는 것으로 일단 대응하며 복구
			UPDATE mov
			SET 
				MoveState = -1,
				Errors = --Errors + 
				@CHARACTER_DELETE_DELAYED
			FROM dbo.CharacterMove AS mov
				INNER JOIN Character AS cha
					ON mov.PCID = cha.PCID
			WHERE MoveState = 0 
				AND CharacterState = 4 -- Deletion Waiting
				AND DeletionDelayTime IS NOT NULL
			
			--4.삭제된 캐릭터 불가
			UPDATE mov
			SET 
				MoveState = -1,
				Errors = --Errors + 
				@CHARACTER_DELETED
			FROM dbo.CharacterMove AS mov
				INNER JOIN Character AS cha
					ON mov.PCID = cha.PCID
			WHERE MoveState = 0 
				AND CharacterState = 3
			
			--5.16레벨미만 캐릭터 불가
			UPDATE mov
			SET 
				MoveState = -1,
				Errors = --Errors + 
				@UNDER16LEVEL
			FROM dbo.CharacterMove AS mov
				INNER JOIN Character AS cha
					ON mov.PCID = cha.PCID
			WHERE MoveState = 0 
				AND CharacterState = 2
				AND Level < 16
			
				
			-- 제한체크 최종상태
			UPDATE dbo.CharacterMove
			SET MoveState = 
				CASE Errors 
					WHEN 0 THEN 1	--Passed@LobbyDB
					ELSE -1 END		--Failed@LobbyDB
			WHERE MoveState = 0
				
		END
		
		IF	(@INIT_TRANCOUNT = 0)
			COMMIT;
		
		RETURN	@ERR_SUCCESS;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF	(XACT_STATE() != 0 AND @INIT_TRANCOUNT = 0)	BEGIN
			ROLLBACK;
			EXEC dbo.usp_LogError;
		END
		
		DECLARE	@ERR_NUMBER		INT				= ERROR_NUMBER(),
				@ERR_SEVERITY	INT				= ERROR_SEVERITY(),
				@ERR_STATE		INT				= ERROR_STATE(),
				@ERR_PROCEDURE	NVARCHAR(126)	= ERROR_PROCEDURE(),
				@ERR_MESSAGE	NVARCHAR(2048)	= ERROR_MESSAGE(),
				@ERR_CODE		INT				= @ERR_FAILURE;
		
		IF	(@ERR_NUMBER >= 50000)	BEGIN
			IF	(@ERR_PROCEDURE = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID))
				SET	@ERR_CODE = @ERR_STATE;
		END
		
		IF	(@@NESTLEVEL = 1)
			RAISERROR(N'[%s], %s', @ERR_SEVERITY, @ERR_CODE, @ERR_PROCEDURE, @ERR_MESSAGE);
		ELSE
			RAISERROR(@ERR_MESSAGE, @ERR_SEVERITY, @ERR_CODE);
		
		RETURN	@ERR_CODE;
	END CATCH
END

		IF	(	ISNULL(@SearchCount, -1) <= 0
				OR	ISNULL(@SearchType, 0) = 0
				OR	ISNULL(@SearchString, N'') = N''
				OR	(@SearchType IN (2, 3) AND ISNULL(@PagingKey, N'') = N'')	)
			RAISERROR(N'invalid parameter, searchCount:%d, searchType:%d, searchString:%s, pagingKey:%s', 16, @ERR_FAILURE,

		BEGIN

				SELECT	[Character].PCID,
						[Character].WorldID,

						[Character].Job,
						[Character].[Level],

				FROM	(

												PCID,
												WorldID,
												Job,

									)	[Character]

						(

									WorldName
							FROM	dbo.GameWorld
							WITH	(READUNCOMMITTED, FORCESEEK)
						)	GameWorld
						ON	GameWorld.WorldID	= [Character].WorldID
				WHERE	CharacterName	LIKE @SearchString + N'%'
				ORDER BY CharacterName ASC;
			END
			ELSE IF (@SearchType = 2)	BEGIN	-- Next
				SELECT	[Character].PCID,
						[Character].WorldID,
						GameWorld.WorldName,
						[Character].Job,
						[Character].[Level],
						[Character].CharacterName
				FROM	(

									WorldID,

									[Level],
									CharacterName

										SELECT	TOP(@SearchCount)
												PCID,
												WorldID,
												Job,
												[Level],
												CharacterName
										FROM	dbo.[Character]
										WITH	(READUNCOMMITTED, INDEX(IX_Character_CharacterName_CharacterState))
										WHERE	CharacterName	> @PagingKey
										AND		CharacterState	IN (2, 3, 4, 5)		-- Creation Completion, Deletion Try, Deletion Waiting, Restoration Try
										ORDER BY CharacterName ASC, CharacterState ASC
									)	[Character]
						)	[Character]

						(
							SELECT	WorldID,
									WorldName
							FROM	dbo.GameWorld
							WITH	(READUNCOMMITTED, FORCESEEK)
